Iran Admits to 'Mistake' After Attacks on Ships in Hormuz Strait

The Iranian government has acknowledged a 'mistake' after attacks on ships in the Hormuz Strait, amid international pressure for Iran to commit to stopping such incidents. The US and other countries have called for Iran to acknowledge that the attacks violated the ceasefire agreement. Meanwhile, some experts argue that maritime miscalculations may have contributed to the deal's failure. The situation highlights the ongoing tensions between Iran and the global community over access to the strategic waterway.
